property_summary: For every transfer call, the callee address must receive one call per recipient whose 4-byte selector equals transferFrom(address,address,uint256), so the reference's recorder sees all N calls while the mutant's recorder sees zero; the mutant is caught because its transfer(address,address,uint256) selector calls a missing function and records nothing.
change_summary: Compute the call selector for transfer(address,address,uint256) instead of transferFrom, causing calls to hit a different or missing function and generally revert.
